sentence_stem: Never before in the history of the company,
correct_completion: had the board approved such a risky investment.
full_sentence: Never before in the history of the company, had the board approved such a risky investment.
acceptable_variants: had any previous board authorised such a risky investment.
had the directors ever backed a venture this dangerous.

options.text: the board approved such a risky investment.
options.why_wrong: After a fronted negative adverbial such as 'Never before', the auxiliary must come before the subject. Without inversion the structure is not correct here.

options.text: the board had approved such a risky investment.
options.why_wrong: The auxiliary 'had' follows the subject, which is the normal order. The fronted negative adverbial requires it to precede the subject.

options.text: the board was approving such a risky investment.
options.why_wrong: A progressive form describes an ongoing action and does not fit the completed-experience meaning, and it cannot take the inverted auxiliary pattern.

options.text: had the board approved such a risky investment.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after a fronted negative adverbial
explanation: A fronted negative adverbial such as 'Never before' triggers inversion, so the auxiliary verb moves in front of the subject. Learners often keep the normal subject-verb order, because Turkish word order is flexible and Turkish has no auxiliary inversion of this kind.
translation: Şirketin tarihinde hiçbir zaman yönetim kurulu bu kadar riskli bir yatırımı onaylamamıştı.
